Production component scanning remains intact. An explicit test-component exclusion prevents unrelated test configurations leaking into programmatic Boot startup.
Six existing collaboration provisioning worker cases, formatCheck and architectureCheck pass.
limits: No queued item is delivered through FCM in the application-context test. Current delivery policy/SQL and actual FCM transport have separate existing evidence.
No live provider, schema or delivery flag is changed. Mobile receive/decrypt/reply and all-owned-company reconnect/periodic recovery remain required before activation.
Four local and sixteen global leases are bounded pilot defaults, not a measured large-company throughput guarantee.
